meta.name: ulw-loop
meta.description: A goal-like loop that decomposes work into systematic, evidence-bound ultrawork steps. Use when the user wants a goal loop or durable, checkpointed execution.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把大目标拆成可验证的步骤,循环执行直到收尾。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常有需要持续推进的大目标,希望分解执行、随时掌握进度。
copy.tagline_en: Break big goals into verified steps and loop through them until completion.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a big goal to pursue and need to split it into small, trackable steps.

howto.what: Claude 会把你的大目标拆成很细的步骤,逐步执行并记录检查点;每步完成都要有可观察的证据,只凭测试不算完成;中途丢了上下文也会从检查点继续,不会重新规划。
howto.when: 当你说“ulw-loop”或“ulw”,或要求做长期、需要分阶段验证的任务时。

say.text: 用 ulw-loop 帮我规划并推进这个项目。
say.note: 它会先读流程、注册目标再拆步骤。

say.text: 我想做一个长期任务,用 ulw-loop 跟踪进度。
say.note: 每步完成都会留下证据。

say.text: 用 ulw 把任务分阶段做,每阶段都要验证。
say.note: 每阶段需提供可观察的结果。

howto.what_en: It decomposes large goals into small steps, executes them while keeping checkpoints, and requires observable evidence for each step. Passing tests alone does not count as done. If context is lost, it resumes from the checkpoint instead of re-planning.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user mentions 'ulw-loop' or 'ulw', or asks for long-running work that needs staged verification and checkpointed execution.

say_en.text: Use ulw-loop to plan and run this project.
say_en.note: It will read the workflow, register goals, and break the work into steps.

say_en.text: I want a long-running task tracked with ulw-loop.
Use ulw to split this into phases and verify each one.
say_en.note: Each phase must show observable results.
